facts.text: Report holder PREFLEX, INC.; subject is structural insulated panels.
SIPs are roof, floor and wall panels, combustible for construction type, and may be used as fire-resistance-rated assemblies per §4.3.1-4.3.3.
Installation and erection per the report, the manufacturer's instructions and the approved construction documents; only listed thicknesses; no span extrapolation.

Where SIP shear walls of different widths are combined in one wall line, or with other shear elements, in SDC D, E or F under the IBC, lateral loads are proportioned by relative stiffness; calculations are sealed by a registered design professional where statutes require.
Identification clause §7.1.1 cites 'ESR-4689' rather than ESR-5318; the discrepancy needs confirmation.
Evidence listed: AC04 (June 2019, editorially revised December 2020); ASTM E455; cyclic shear per AC04 Appendix A; ASTM E119; NFPA 286.
